skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to analyze, evaluate, and ensure the security and confidentiality of information systems.
Manage time and resources effectively, adapt to changes, and communicate effectively in both written and oral forms.
Design, develop, operate, and manage information systems to solve specific problems.
Conduct independent research and work under pressure.
Work effectively in a team, organize group activities, and evaluate team members' performance.
Adhere to laws and regulations, and maintain social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Security.

prerequisite_courses: Accumulated 75% of credits in the curriculum
